description: This file contains benchmarking code for the 'randen' random number generator implementation within the Abseil library, including functions to measure performance of various components like absorb and generate functions, and the randen engine.

classes.name: AbsorbFn
classes.description: Template struct for benchmarking the 'Absorb' function of Randen implementations.

classes.name: GenerateFn
classes.description: Template struct for benchmarking the 'Generate' function of Randen implementations.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: Template struct for benchmarking the randen engine with different unsigned integer types.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Executes the benchmark operation for AbsorbFn, GenerateFn, or Engine, returning the first element of the state or rng output.

methods.name: Print
methods.description: Prints benchmarking results including ticks, time, and throughput in MB/s.

methods.name: Measure
methods.description: Runs the benchmark for a given operation and inputs, then prints the results.

methods.name: RunAll
methods.description: Sets CPU affinity if specified, defines input sizes, and runs benchmarks for various Randen components.
